findings.title: Terminal attempts always have receipts
findings.proposition: Require a non-null owner receipt for every terminal JJ attempt, including failed, cancelled, recovery-required and effect-unknown results.

findings.title: Nominal reads may write
findings.proposition: Classify and fence all effects of nominal reads: snapshots, ref import, head reconciliation, secure-config migration, lazy object hydration, index rebuilds and unpublished operation-diff objects.

findings.title: Strict read-only repository mode
findings.proposition: Offer repository browsing when the original native store is mounted strictly read-only.

findings.title: Writer authority is stronger than native locks
findings.proposition: Retain one admitted writer across UI, CLI, watchers, fetch/import and external Git activity; native advisory locks and timeouts do not establish ownership.

findings.title: Expected operation is not native compare-and-swap
findings.proposition: Check the exact expected operation and immutable target under the writer lease, including after long fetches; --at-operation alone only chooses a native starting view.

findings.title: Exact durable identity and operation-local selectors
findings.proposition: Keep repository, environment, workspace, mutable change, immutable commit, operation and operation-local selector identities separate across selection, caching and mutation.

findings.title: Process failure and cancellation are not no-effect proof
findings.proposition: Report actual multi-stage effects, partial publication and checkout progress, retain warnings, and reconcile unknown effects before retrying after timeout or cancellation.

findings.title: Partial multi-file resolve
findings.proposition: Preserve earlier accepted resolutions when a later external merge tool fails, and report their native after-state rather than claiming the entire resolve did nothing.

findings.title: Unknown auth retry effects
findings.proposition: Do not copy fail-prompt-retry credential flows unless the prior operation is proven safe to replay under the same command instance.

findings.title: Native versus sidecar crash boundary
findings.proposition: Keep native objects, refs, workspace files and sidecar metadata independently observable across partial failure; recover from inconsistent state without trusting a healthy-looking graph.

findings.title: Native recovery has explicit scope
findings.proposition: Keep undo, inverse-one-operation, full-view restore, workspace path recovery and external-file recovery distinct; undo never reverses a remote push.

findings.title: Operation diff baseline safety
findings.proposition: Compare the correct recorded workspace or committed baseline when presenting an operation diff, excluding unrelated dirty work.

findings.title: Named operation waypoints
findings.proposition: Let users name and revisit operation waypoints without creating artificial native history entries.

findings.title: Grouped operation history and undo
findings.proposition: Group an intentional multi-command history edit for review and, where supported, one user-level undo.

findings.title: Operation history navigation
findings.proposition: Add recent-operation and redo navigation with a virtualized operation timeline.

findings.title: Operation history filtering
findings.proposition: Add user-facing filtering of noisy operation history by action, time or meaningful milestone.

findings.title: Structured operation descriptions
findings.proposition: Attach structured application action descriptions and correlation metadata to operation-history presentation.

findings.title: History maintenance policy
findings.proposition: Choose whether PM merely diagnoses operation-history growth or offers user-approved pruning/garbage collection.

findings.title: Stale workspace recovery
findings.proposition: Expose stale workspaces and saved/unpublished recovery operations without destructive refresh or guessing the newest operation.

findings.title: Workspace adoption and synchronization
findings.proposition: Support explicit adoption, rename/path repair and synchronization of existing native or Git workspaces where qualified.

findings.title: Workspace archival visibility
findings.proposition: Allow a workspace to be hidden or archived without removing its files or claiming it disappeared from native history.

findings.title: Divergent change convergence
findings.proposition: Offer explicit convergence of multiple visible commits sharing one change identity.

findings.title: Additional history-editing actions
findings.proposition: Consider duplicate, merge, absorb and back-out actions beyond the currently enumerated Jujutsu change commands.

findings.title: Interdiff
findings.proposition: Offer a comparison of two versions of a change rather than only their from/to file trees.

findings.title: Change evolution view
findings.proposition: Add a dedicated per-change evolution view for predecessors, rewrites and abandoned versions.

findings.title: Native annotation and file history
findings.proposition: Add Jujutsu-native line attribution and rename-aware file history where supported.

findings.title: Persistent review marks
findings.proposition: Preserve reviewed markers and line-anchored notes across matching rewrites, with stale or orphaned status when correspondence is uncertain.

findings.title: Machine-readable hunk selection
findings.proposition: Expose machine-readable partial-change specifications for agents and scripts through the existing adapter authority.

findings.title: Hunk and editable diff safety
findings.proposition: Bind partial-edit selections and editable diff saves to both rendered sides, native conflict state, exact session/repository/revision, and complete matched selections.

findings.title: Empty, absent and failed reads are distinct
findings.proposition: Never turn missing content, a failed native query, traversal omission or unsupported type into a valid empty file/list.

findings.title: Diff text and metadata round-trip
findings.proposition: Preserve untouched source bytes, deletion state and file metadata through diff editors; saving unchanged text must not silently normalize line endings.

findings.title: Edited text line-ending policy
findings.proposition: Choose only the newline convention for genuinely newly inserted or replaced newline boundaries in mixed-ending edited text, preserving existing CRLF/LF/CR on ordinary Save.

findings.title: External editor path confinement
findings.proposition: Protect output roots, links, ancestor directories and file identities so an admitted relative filename cannot write outside the authorized output tree.

findings.title: Partial external editor writes
findings.proposition: Distinguish whole-request validation rejection from I/O failure after one or more external editor files were written.

findings.title: External diff and merge tool handoff
findings.proposition: Offer a managed external diff/merge tool session, including supported remote forwarding, with readiness, save, exit, cancel and cleanup tracked separately.

findings.title: External editor stale sessions
findings.proposition: Reject late saves from a stale diff or merge session even when a replacement repository exposes identical relative filenames.

findings.title: Bound reads before allocating
findings.proposition: Bound file reads, scan work and concurrent content fetches before allocating unbounded buffers, and preserve partial/error states.

findings.title: Credential architecture and custody already chosen
findings.proposition: Use the exact owner-brokered HTTPS/SSH credential paths, operation-scoped leases, authenticated IPC, typed waits/cancellation and safe helper progress; do not copy a competing raw askpass architecture.

findings.title: Secret logging and redaction
findings.proposition: Keep credential values out of debug logs, receipts, artifacts and ordinary GUI state, and retain only owner-approved non-secret references.

findings.title: Credential storage alternatives conflict with owner policy
findings.proposition: Do not adopt an application-secret backend that may delegate to plaintext Git credential storage or silently replace configured secret material.

findings.title: SSH host trust is a separate decision
findings.proposition: Preserve SSH confirmation/notification kinds and exact host-key trust decisions rather than accepting unknown host keys or displaying every request as a password field.

findings.title: Null standard input does not prove no terminal
findings.proposition: Reject the claim that stdin=null and stderr=piped universally make Git/SSH unable to reach a terminal.

findings.title: Authenticated browser and local IPC
findings.proposition: Authenticate local editor/server sessions, bind caller/repository identity and avoid reusing stale incompatible server instances.

findings.title: Adapter implementation shape
findings.proposition: Choose an adapter implementation based on the qualified CLI, embedded native libraries, or a separately owned internal service while keeping all consumers behind one owner.

findings.title: Upstream RPC is not available
findings.proposition: Treat upstream jj api and high-level UI-library extraction as unshipped proposals rather than available dependencies.

findings.title: Reusable diff library
findings.proposition: Decide whether to reuse an independently licensed native diff library beneath the Rust/Slint UI.

findings.title: External IDE clients
findings.proposition: Expose the Source Control owner to selected external IDE clients without transferring native mutation authority to them.

findings.title: Multi-host reusable server
findings.proposition: Offer a reusable multi-repository service for external or remote UI clients.

findings.title: MCP access to native actions
findings.proposition: Consider an MCP-facing source-control client that invokes the same admitted command family.

findings.title: Included tools and exact qualification
findings.proposition: Retain included pinned tools, exact engine/CLI/repository-format and environment qualification, and truthful unsupported capability states.

findings.title: Colocated import/export stays fail-closed
findings.proposition: Keep explicit colocated import/export unavailable by default and require the exact certified preflight for any compatibility mutation.

findings.title: Git HEAD and index health are separate
findings.proposition: Qualify colocated Git HEAD, index entries and exact index recovery state separately from JJ status.

findings.title: Windows links and native file types
findings.proposition: Distinguish a Windows link/reparse point from its target and qualify file, symlink, hardlink and type transitions by exact native identity.

findings.title: Effective config and template parsing
findings.proposition: Respect qualified config precedence and force explicit machine templates/escaping so user presentation settings cannot silently change adapter results.

findings.title: State is not foreign configuration
findings.proposition: Keep high-churn UI state separate from externally managed Jujutsu configuration.

findings.title: Native conflict truth and supported shape
findings.proposition: Preserve native multi-term conflict state, side provenance, supported marker/type shapes and terminal reconciliation; clean-looking text is insufficient.

findings.title: Exact-profile conflict byte regression
findings.proposition: Account for the known 0.44 carriage-return conflict round-trip defect when qualifying conflict editing.

findings.title: Publishing conflicted changes
findings.proposition: Choose whether qualified users may intentionally publish commits containing unresolved native JJ conflicts.

findings.title: Push targets and bookmark effects
findings.proposition: Preserve bookmark local/remote/tracked/absent/conflicted state and preview exact remote/ref, tag, tracking and descendant effects.

findings.title: Guided bookmark conflict resolution
findings.proposition: Offer a guided target picker for conflicted bookmarks and explicit review of their local/remote targets.

findings.title: Graph bounds, continuity and isolation
findings.proposition: Bind bounded graph pages to exact operation/projection identity, isolate cursors per query/caller, preserve geometry and selection, and expose missing/partial edges.

findings.title: Graph visual and menu regressions
findings.proposition: Verify actual native menu/compositor routes, graph edges, drag targets, empty selection and contrast after rendering or lifetime changes.

findings.title: Graph branch prioritization
findings.proposition: Let users prioritize selected branches/stacks in graph lane layout.

findings.title: Hidden graph regression qualification
findings.proposition: Test prioritized/hidden-revision graph queries against the exact supported native version.

findings.title: Revset assistance
findings.proposition: Add autocomplete and signature help for advanced native history queries.

findings.title: Direct graph manipulation
findings.proposition: Support drag-to-rebase/reorder and multi-selection with explicit effect previews, busy-state gating and keyboard alternatives.

findings.title: Focused comparison conveniences
findings.proposition: Add revision pinning, context-sensitive previews, inversion navigation and selected-revision bookmark details in the existing comparison surface.

findings.title: Description drafts survive refresh
findings.proposition: Preserve unsubmitted change-description drafts across exact-identity refreshes and clearly separate drafts from committed history.

findings.title: Immutable content caches and async selection
findings.proposition: Separate immutable content keys from mutable UI/projection generations, quarantine late responses and never cache degraded data as complete.

findings.title: Watcher reconnection and exclusions
findings.proposition: Treat watchers as invalidation hints, resolve shared-store indirection, and show stale state during missed events, reconnect or permanent watcher failure.

findings.title: Queue reentrancy and dependency deadlocks
findings.proposition: Prevent nested queue/lock acquisition from deadlocking refresh, editor, authentication or mutation completion.

findings.title: One catalog and authoritative eligibility
findings.proposition: Route all surfaces through one canonical action catalog with authoritative eligibility rechecks, idempotent command instances and exact work attribution.

findings.title: Runtime evidence versus unused scaffolding
findings.proposition: Do not count unused file-lock schemas, nominal capability flags or handler strings as production serialization or certification.

findings.title: Process execution follows owner environment
findings.proposition: Route Git/SSH, signing, filters, hooks, configured tools and forge sidecars through the exact owner environment and process policy.

findings.title: PTY and shell decisions already resolved
findings.proposition: Use the canonical terminal owner for any genuinely interactive subprocess capability rather than adding a competing PTY or terminal engine.

findings.title: Keyboard and ordinary settings surfaces
findings.proposition: Reuse the existing shortcut registry, remapping/conflict handling and owner-routed Settings UI.

findings.title: AI description assistance already present
findings.proposition: Reuse advisory generated commit/change descriptions through existing Source Control commands, with explicit user acceptance.

findings.title: Dedicated workspace AI review
findings.proposition: Offer an explicitly scoped AI review session for one workspace.

findings.title: Complete retained native backup closure
findings.proposition: Capture the complete retained native operation/view/object/dependency/workspace closure and dirty physical files under one barrier and GC fence.

findings.title: Snapshot omission and skipped checkout
findings.proposition: Distinguish physical dirty/untracked/ignored/large or invalid-UTF8 files from the recorded native tree, including successful commands with skipped paths.

findings.title: Backup existence is not verified recovery
findings.proposition: Verify destination bytes, complete native object interpretation and an isolated selected historical-operation restore before activation.

findings.title: Extras head integrity and crash corruption
findings.proposition: Qualify extras-head/segment correspondence, object contents and keep-ref integrity; do not call every missing object corruption or assume reindex repairs every native store.

findings.title: Backup derived indexes
findings.proposition: Choose whether recoverable backups retain native derived indexes or rebuild them during isolated verification.

findings.title: Sanitized inactive restore configuration
findings.proposition: Keep restored helpers, hooks, filters, config IDs, includes, remote credentials and owner references inactive until their owners revalidate them.

findings.title: Capture generation differs from upload resume
findings.proposition: Keep resumable transfer/setup phases bound to their exact capture/destination generation and evidence, rather than treating a retry as proof of a consistent new snapshot.

findings.title: Clone completion and cleanup
findings.proposition: Track clone setup, fetch, preset writing, checkout and residual-directory cleanup with exact destination identity; protect existing and dirty directories.

findings.title: Read preview and dry-run side effects
findings.proposition: Do not assume preview, dry-run or immutable-override retry is read-only or newly authorized merely because a client labels it that way.

findings.title: Parent retention in history edits
findings.proposition: Preserve exact merge-parent and descendant semantics when implementing native rebase or multi-parent change operations.

findings.title: Partial clone and LFS/submodule eligibility
findings.proposition: Give partial/promisor, LFS and nested/submodule repositories explicit qualification and backup-closure dispositions; never silently hydrate or fall back to Git mutation.

findings.title: Authorized incomplete-object materialization
findings.proposition: Add an explicit authorized workflow to obtain missing promisor/LFS objects for inspection or complete retained-history backup.

findings.title: Large-repository storage expansion
findings.proposition: Consider virtual filesystem, content-defined chunking or specialized large-file backends for very large repositories.

findings.title: Performance mechanisms are not capability proof
findings.proposition: Measure graph/query/snapshot/ref-import costs independently and keep bounds and progress labels honest.

findings.title: Worker panic isolation
findings.proposition: Contain worker panics without losing command outcome or blocking all future repository work.

findings.title: Operation metadata is not idempotency
findings.proposition: Treat native operation descriptions and rewritten operation IDs as evidence, not a replacement for durable command-instance identity.

findings.title: Redacted operation diagnostic export
findings.proposition: Offer an explicit sanitized export of native operation diagnostics for support and review.

findings.title: Inspectable source command log
findings.proposition: Offer a human-readable source-control command/effect log sourced from existing receipts.

findings.title: Hosting, transport and local history remain separate
findings.proposition: Keep forge accounts, PR/CI caches and remote transport separate from local Jujutsu identity and authority.

findings.title: Automatic fetch and checks already owner-routed
findings.proposition: Reuse existing authorized Home Server observation for automatic fetch/CI projections rather than starting per-client pollers.

findings.title: Stacked reviews
findings.proposition: Offer a workflow that publishes related changes as an ordered stack of hosted reviews with explicit base relationships.

findings.title: Additional forge workflow support
findings.proposition: Consider native Gerrit and other additional forge-specific review workflows through the existing forge owner.

findings.title: Third-party Jujutsu push hooks
findings.proposition: Allow explicitly configured third-party push hooks around native Jujutsu publication.

findings.title: Upstream narrative inconsistencies
findings.proposition: Resolve stale upstream prose and incomplete investigations against the more specific supplied implementation evidence.

findings.title: Reverse one selected native operation
findings.proposition: Offer a separately labeled action that inversely merges one selected native operation into the current view, distinct from sequential Undo and full-view Restore.

findings.title: Isolated rewrite preview and promotion
findings.proposition: Offer an explicitly admitted isolated rewrite preview that creates an unintegrated native operation, then separately admits integration or restoration after review.

findings.title: Browse the repository at a past operation
findings.proposition: Offer repository browsing pinned to the view at one selected historical operation, distinct from per-change evolution and from restoring that state.

findings.title: Restore readiness consistency
findings.proposition: The existing backup JJ restore-verification validation contract must reject ready_for_owner_activation when workspace_map_result is collision_blocked, colocation_activation_disposition is blocked_dual_writer_or_identity_collision, or working_copy_relation is unverified.
findings.distinctness: F001 concerns missing/non-null terminal command receipts. This candidate concerns contradictory readiness inside an already-present, typed BackupJujutsuRestoreVerificationReceipt. Adding a terminal receipt does not enforce this receipt content.

findings.title: Graph page consistency and adjacency bounds
findings.proposition: The existing SourceGraph contract needs enforceable relational validation of emitted node counts/page bounds, usable continuation on a current page claiming more data, unambiguous node identity, and a finite parent-reference expansion policy, rather than relying only on per-field bounds and boolean declarations.
findings.distinctness: F001 governs terminal mutation/work receipts; this is a read-only graph projection consistency obligation. A required terminal receipt cannot repair page/count/node identity/reference validation.

findings.title: Clone identity before native initialization
findings.proposition: The existing Jujutsu clone request/result contract must represent the legitimate destination-not-yet-initialized phase without requiring fabricated native commit/change/operation/snapshot identities; initialized repository operations retain their exact native fences.
findings.distinctness: F001 requires terminal attempt evidence to exist. This candidate asks how pre-init native state is truthfully represented even when the terminal receipt exists; adding receipt_ref does not permit absent native before-state.

findings.title: Required transport credential evidence
findings.proposition: The existing neutral credential_lease must require use_http_path for HTTPS and known_hosts_receipt_ref plus forwarding_disabled for SSH, while retaining the existing true/nonempty constraints.
findings.distinctness: Terminal receipt presence does not constrain credential-lease transport evidence. These are different records and lifecycle boundaries.

findings.title: New-repository object-format selection
findings.proposition: Offer an evidence-gated user choice of object format when creating a new JJ repository, and show discovered effective format for existing repositories.
findings.distinctness: F050 requires exact engine/CLI/repository-format qualification and truthful unsupported states. It does not require exposing a creation-time user selection control. Qualification is a prerequisite to the picker, not the picker itself.

limits: One frozen case, unequal inherited history and terminal coverage; not a general model ranking.
Recall is against the adjudicated union, not an external exhaustive truth set.
Unsupported/rejected includes already-covered proposals; it is not a false-positive rate.
Budget-limited saved findings count when supported; unperformed research remains unknown.
No runtime certification or automatic product adoption.
